questions.Description: 1) Prepare a project schedule for minimum 8 activities and calculate EST (Earliest Start Time), EFT (Earliest Finish Time), LST (Latest Start Time) and LFT (Latest Finish Time) using excel formulas and verify them in MS Project.
2) Prepare a Key Plan and Job Layout drawing for a G+2 residential building using Revit/AutoCAD/Sketch Up. Indicate utility areas, approach road, storage yard, and labour camp.

3) Develop a PERT Network for minimum 6 given activities in MS Excel and MS Project. Find TE (Expected Time), TL (Latest Time), and Slack for each activity, using excel formulas and verify them in MS Project.
4) For a given set of activity durations (Optimistic, Most Likely, Pessimistic), compute the Standard Deviation and Variance for each activity using Excel formulas and verify them in MS Project.

5) Prepare a Measurement Book (M-Book) in Excel for brick masonry work carried out over 10 days. Include date of measurement, contractor details, quantity entries, cumulative abstract, and final summary.
6) Using MS Excel, prepare a Comparative Statement between minimum five tender quotations for an RCC framed structure contract. Recommend the most suitable tender.
7) Develop a CPM Network for minimum 6 given activities in MS Project. Calculate man hours for each activity and link with scheduling.
8) Using MS Project, prepare a detailed CPM (Critical Path Method) analysis for minimum 8 activities. Highlight the Critical Path and prepare both the network diagram and Gantt chart.

9) Using MS Project PERT analysis, calculate Expected Durations, Standard Deviation, and Project Completion Probability for a project with minimum 5 dummy activities (Optimistic, Pessimistic, Most Likely durations provided).

From the given activity durations and dependency relationships, prepare a PERT network in Excel. Identify critical activities, floats, and expected project completion time and validate using MS Project.
